definitions: The act or process of setting up an idol or image of the Hindu deity Ganapati (Ganesha) for worship, especially during festivals like Ganesh Chaturthi.
The physical setup or arrangement of a Ganapati idol and associated decorations for religious observance.
examples: The Ganapati installation was elaborate this year.
They prepared for the Ganapati installation with great devotion.
The community gathered for the Ganapati installation ceremony.
